_comment: Curated overrides for subrace trait/power replacements. Keyed by subrace entry id. Each entry may list base trait/power/feat NAMES (replacesTraits) and/or base entry IDS (replacesPowerIds/replacesFeatIds) that the subrace replaces. These are merged with the auto-parsed replacements from the subrace body. Add entries here when the parser misses a 'replaces ...' wording. Example: "race67": { "replacesTraits": ["Dragon Breath"], "replacesPowerIds": [], "replacesFeatIds": [] }
